newsitem.title: USA: Wayne Savings Q3 Dec 31 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Wayne Savings Q3 Dec 31 net rises.

text.p: The Wayne Savings and Loan Co of Wooster, Ohio, said it had net earnings of $401,000, or $0.27 per share, for the third fiscal quarter ended December 31, 1996. This represents an increase of 19 percent over net earnings of $336,000, or $0.23 per share, reported in the same quarter a year ago.

The company said the rise in earnings was primarily due to a $75,000 increase in net interest income and a $67,000 decrease in operating expenses, including a $21,000 reduction in the deposit insurance premium, when compared to the third fiscal quarter last year. These positive earnings factors were partially offset by a $60,000 decrease in other income, due to lower gains on sale of loans and other assets in the quarter ended December 31, 1996.

For the nine month period ended December 31, 1996, excluding the one-time SAIF deposit insurance assessment and a fixed asset write-off booked on September 30, 1996, net earnings amounted to $1,243,000, or $0.84 per share, a 23 percent increase over net earnings of $1,010,000, or $0.69 per share recorded in the same nine month period last year. Finn said the increase in net earnings was largely due to an increase in net interest income, from $5.8 million to $6.1 million. Including payment of the one-time SAIF deposit insurance assessment of $887,000 after-tax and a fixed asset write-off of $75,000 after tax on September 30, 1996, net earnings for the nine months ending December 31, 1996 totaled $281,000 or $0.15 per share.

At December 31, 1996, total assets amounted to $250.0 million, an increase of $1.5 million as compared to $248.5 million on March 31, 1996. Net loans receivable increased in the nine month period to $209.4 million from $206.5 million. Stockholders equity totaled $22.8 million on December 31, 1996, a capital-to-assets ratio of 9.12 percent.
